title: Cardiovascular disease: risk assessment and reduction, including lipid modification
authors: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
journal: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence, NICE guideline NG238
result: Recommendation 1.12.5: do not offer omega-3 fatty acid compounds to prevent cardiovascular disease; icosapent ethyl used as described in technology appraisal TA805 is an exception [2014, amended December 2023]. Recommendation 1.12.6: tell people that there is no evidence that omega-3 fatty acid compounds help to prevent cardiovascular disease, except icosapent ethyl as described in TA805. Recommendation 1.12.7: do not offer the combination of a statin with an omega-3 fatty acid compound, except icosapent ethyl as described in TA805.
